summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the 'Bannr' mobile-first banner builder (Vite+React19 SPA, no backend). Covered: Home (header/Recent x3/Templates x6), PresetPicker (4 category tabs, preset selection), template open, Editor layout, all 6 primary tools + bottom sheets, add text/5 shapes/sticker/stock image, font/color/style/align/opacity/radius/mask panels, duplicate/delete/reorder, Layers panel (select, visibility, up/down, delete), Animate panel, Timeline (play/pause, scrub, zoom in/out, clip select, trim L/R), Export sheet (format/quality/progress/done), back navigation, sheet containment inside the 440px device frame, mobile (390x844) + desktop (1920x1080) viewports. NO uncaught JS/console errors were observed in any flow. Most interactions work, but 3 critical defects were found: (1) artboard is squeezed by flexbox so every banner renders at the wrong aspect ratio with layers spilling outside the canvas, (2) `mode` is never exposed by the editor context so Animated mode is completely dead (no active state, no animations, no clip-range visibility, export always offers static formats), (3) double-tap text editing inserts characters in reverse order.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: artboard renders at the WRONG ASPECT RATIO and layers spill outside the canvas. The artboard div (width:preset.w) is a flex item inside `flex flex-1 items-center justify-center` and gets flex-shrunk: for preset ig-post (1080x1080) computed width is 390px while height stays 1080px, so the scaled box measures 121x335 (aspect 0.36 instead of 1.0). Background only paints the squeezed strip while text/shape/sticker/image layers render outside it and get clipped by the device frame. Repro: New Banner -> preset-ig-post -> add text; measured getBoundingClientRect = {w:121.1, h:335.4}, computed style width '390px'. Fix: add `shrink-0` (flex-shrink:0) to the artboard div (or wrap it in a non-flex centering wrapper) so its layout width stays preset.w.

CRITICAL: `mode` is destructured from useEditor() in TopBar.tsx:6, Canvas.tsx:49 and ExportSheet.tsx:6 but the context State/Ctx never expose it (it lives on project.mode) -> it is `undefined` at runtime. Consequences verified in the browser: (a) mode-static/mode-animated never get the active `bg-accent` class, so the toggle looks dead; (b) Canvas `animated` is always false so animations (rise/fade/pop/slide) never play and layers are NOT hidden outside their clip range (scrubbed to 3.6s past a trimmed clip end, layer opacity still 1); (c) ExportSheet always offers PNG/JPG/SVG - MP4/GIF are never offered even after switching to Animated. `npx tsc --noEmit` confirms: "Property 'mode' does not exist on type 'Ctx'" (3 occurrences). Fix: add `mode: 'static' | 'animated'` to Ctx and set `mode: state.project.mode` in the provider value.

CRITICAL: double-tap text editing types characters in REVERSE ORDER. Repro: open template-t-poster, dblclick text layer 'LIVE', type ' EDITED' -> result is 'DETIDE LIVE'. Root cause: the contentEditable is controlled ({layer.text} as children) and each onInput dispatches updateLayer, React re-renders the node and resets the caret to offset 0, so every keystroke is inserted at the start. Fix: render text uncontrolled (set initial content once via ref/defaultValue and only commit on blur), or restore the selection after update.

project-title button collapses to 0px width at the mobile frame width (measured {w:0, h:20} at 390px viewport; innerText 'Untitled Banner1:1'). The project name/ratio is invisible and the rename affordance is unreachable on mobile - the primary target device. Caused by too many fixed-width siblings (mode toggle + undo + redo + Export) in a 440px row against a `flex-1 min-w-0` title. Fix: shrink/move the mode toggle, drop undo/redo icons or move the title to its own row.

The 6th primary tool ('Layers') is clipped off the device frame: toolbar clientWidth 390 vs scrollWidth 420, tool-layers right edge = 412 > toolbar right edge = 390. It is horizontally scrollable but there is no scroll affordance, so it reads as a broken/cut-off button on a 390px phone. Fix: reduce w-16 to w-14 / tighten gaps so all 6 fit, or add a visible fade/scroll hint.

At the default zoom (ppms 0.09) a full-duration 5s clip is 450px wide inside a ~294px visible track, so the RIGHT trim handle sits off-screen (bounding box x=537 on a 390px viewport) and is untappable until the user discovers horizontal scrolling. Verified working after two zoom-out clicks (clip 150px -> trimmed to 100px). Left trim works at default zoom. Fix: default the zoom so the project duration fits the track width (fit-to-duration), or clamp/pin the right handle into view.

undo-btn, redo-btn and split-btn are rendered as enabled-looking controls but are complete no-ops (no onClick). They should be disabled/greyed or removed in the prototype to avoid dead-click confusion.

time-display uses `seconds:centiseconds`, so a 5000ms duration renders as '5:00' (reads as 5 minutes) and playback shows impossible-looking values like '3:60'. Fix: use mm:ss.cs or '3.60s' style formatting.

integration_issues.flow: Animate -> Animated mode -> Timeline preview -> Export
integration_issues.issue: Applying an animation (anim-rise) correctly dispatches setMode('animated') into project.mode, but because the context does not expose `mode`, nothing downstream reacts: no active toggle state, no animation/clip-range rendering on the canvas during playback, and export formats stay PNG/JPG/SVG. The entire 'animated banner' value proposition is non-functional end to end.

issues: Artboard aspect ratio is wrong for every preset and layers render outside the banner bounds (see ui_bugs) - this makes the core WYSIWYG canvas untrustworthy.
Top bar is overcrowded at 390-440px: project name is fully squeezed out (0px).
6th tool label clipped at the frame edge with no scroll affordance.
Timeline default zoom does not fit the project duration, pushing clip ends and right trim handles off-screen.
search-btn is a visible control with no behaviour (dead click).
Otherwise strong: dark theme contrast is fine, Recent (3) and Templates (6) render, all remote images loaded (0 broken images).

action_items: Add `shrink-0` / flex-shrink:0 to the artboard in Canvas.tsx so preset dimensions are respected (fixes wrong aspect ratio + layers spilling outside the banner).

Expose `mode` from the editor store: add `mode: 'static' | 'animated'` to Ctx and `mode: state.project.mode` to the provider value (fixes mode toggle active state, animated canvas preview, clip-range visibility and MP4/GIF export formats).
Fix double-tap text editing so typed characters are not reversed (uncontrolled contentEditable committing on blur, or restore caret after updateLayer).
Make the project title visible/tappable at 390-440px widths (top bar layout rework).
Fit all 6 primary tools inside the 390px toolbar (or add a scroll affordance).
Default the timeline zoom to fit project duration so clip ends and right trim handles are reachable.
Disable or remove no-op controls (undo-btn, redo-btn, split-btn, search-btn) or wire them up.
Fix time formatting in Timeline fmt() (5000ms currently renders as '5:00'; values like '3:60' appear).
Add a typecheck step (`tsc --noEmit`) to the build - the `mode` bug would have been caught at build time; the build script currently runs vite only.
critical_code_review_comments: store/editor.tsx: State/Ctx omit `mode` while three components consume it -> silent `undefined`. This is the root cause of all animated-mode failures. Prefer deriving `mode` in the provider value from project.mode.
Canvas.tsx:49: `selected` is destructured but unused (dead code) and TS reports it.

Canvas.tsx:232: `ref={(el) => el && editing && el.focus()}` returns a value (null) from a callback ref - React 19 treats a non-function return as an error/warning. Use `ref={(el) => { el?.focus() }}` with an explicit block body.
Panels.tsx useSel(): `selected!` non-null assertion - if the selected layer is deleted while a contextual sheet is open, panels will throw. Guard with an early return.
Timeline.tsx:79 keyframe-btn: `project.layers.find(l => l.id === selectedId)!.end` will crash if selectedId points at a removed layer. Use optional chaining.

Timeline.tsx: the pointermove effect depends on `updateLayer`/`setTime` which are recreated on every render (provider value is a fresh object, not memoized) - the window listeners are torn down and re-added on every state change. Wrap the store callbacks in useCallback and the value in useMemo.
store/editor.tsx: `duplicate` generates ids with Math.random() while data.ts has a uid() helper - consolidate to one id generator.

Editor is a client-only prototype with no persistence: renames, layers and background changes are lost on Home navigation (Recent thumbnails never update). Fine for a mock, but call it out before backend wiring.

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a Vite SPA at the preview root (no /api, no backend, no routing - view toggles between Home and Editor). Preview URL: https://d4afb135-e60c-44c7-8ebd-8c442bcd4568.preview.emergentagent.com. /app/frontend is a symlink to /app/apps/web. Use `cd /app/apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit` (ignore src/components/ui/** shadcn errors - those files are unused leftovers with missing deps) to catch type-level regressions. VERIFIED WORKING and no need to re-test in depth: home listings, preset picker + all 4 category tabs, template open (t-summer 4 layers, t-yt, t-poster), add text/all 5 shapes/sticker/stock image, font/color/style sliders/align/opacity/radius/mask panels, cut+merge mocked buttons, background solid/gradient/image, layers panel (select/hide/up/down/delete), duplicate/delete/reorder, timeline play-pause + scrub + zoom in/out + clip-click selection + left trim (and right trim once zoomed out), export sheet full flow (progress -> done), back navigation, bottom sheets stay contained in the 440px frame at 1920px. RETEST AFTER FIX: artboard aspect ratio for several presets (square, story 9:16, mrec 300x250), animated mode (toggle active state, animations playing during playback, layers hidden outside clip range, MP4/GIF export formats), double-tap text edit character order, project title visibility at 390px, toolbar fitting 6 tools.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Artboard distortion: the artboard is a direct flex child of the canvas container with an explicit width of preset.w px; default flex-shrink:1 lets flexbox shrink it to the 390px container width while its height (1080px) is untouched, so the CSS `transform: scale()` then produces a non-uniform-looking box (121x335 for a 1:1 preset) and absolutely-positioned children render outside the painted background. 2) Animated mode dead: `mode` is read from the editor context in TopBar/Canvas/ExportSheet but was never added to the Ctx interface or the provider value, so it evaluates to undefined; TypeScript flags it but the build script never runs tsc, so it shipped silently. 3) Reversed text input: the contentEditable node is React-controlled - onInput -> updateLayer -> re-render replaces children with layer.text and resets the caret to offset 0, so each subsequent character is prepended.
